incidents.summary: Petra agreed to an approximately €5 million settlement with 96 Tanzanian claimants following human rights abuses at its Williamson mine, where its investigation confirmed loss of life, injury and mistreatment.

sources.title: Tanzania:  How Petra Diamonds has used grievance mechanisms to remediate human rights abuses; incl. co. response - Business and Human Rights Centre
sources.quote: Reports of abuse had circulated unaddressed since at least 2011.

sources.title: Tanzania:  How Petra Diamonds has used grievance mechanisms to remediate human rights abuses; incl. co. response - Business and Human Rights Centre
sources.quote: which confirmed the loss of life, injury and mistreatment of intruders caused by the mine’s private security guards and police operating on Williamson Diamonds’ concession.

sources.title: Tanzania:  How Petra Diamonds has used grievance mechanisms to remediate human rights abuses; incl. co. response - Business and Human Rights Centre
sources.quote: In May 2021, Petra agreed to a settlement with 96 Tanzanian claimants, committing to a detailed settlement package worth approximately €5 million.

incidents.summary: A tailings dam breach at Petra's Williamson mine flooded nearby houses and farmland, caused three reported minor injuries and prompted a suspension of operations for up to three months.

sources.title: Petra Diamonds' Tanzania mine ops suspended for three months | Reuters
sources.quote: has suspended operations at its Williamson mine in Tanzania for up to three months after a wall of the tailings dam at the site was breached earlier this week

sources.title: Petra Diamonds' Tanzania mine ops suspended for three months | Reuters
sources.quote: said there had been no fatalities as a result of the incident and three minor injuries had been reported

sources.title: Nemc sends experts to assess dam breach at Mwadui diamond mine | The Citizen
sources.quote: the mud had damaged some of the houses and farmland that are now flooded.

incidents.summary: HMRC filed a winding-up petition against Petra's wholly owned UK Treasury subsidiary over approximately £5.65 million in corporation tax due for the year ended June 2025.

sources.title: Petra Diamonds Limited - Update in relation to Petra Diamonds UK Treasury Limited
sources.quote: a winding-up petition in respect of Petra Diamonds UK Treasury Limited (" PDUK Treasury"), a wholly owned, indirect subsidiary of the Company, has today been advertised in the London Gazette by HM Revenue & Customs

sources.title: Petra Diamonds Limited - Update in relation to Petra Diamonds UK Treasury Limited
sources.quote: in respect of £5,647,811.32 for the year ended 30 June 2025, due to HMRC in relation to corporation tax.

sources.title: Petra Diamonds Limited - Update in relation to Petra Diamonds UK Treasury Limited
sources.quote: The Petition has been filed with the court and the hearing date for the Petition is scheduled for 14 October 2026.
